meta_title: pepo — a new way to chat
meta_description: A clean, consistent chat client for Twitch — with 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ emotes, followed channels, and a composer that stays out of the way. Cross-platform desktop, open source.
hero_subtitle: A clean, standalone chat client for Twitch. With support for 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ emotes.
hero_feature_emotes: 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes, out of the box
hero_feature_platforms: Runs on macOS, Windows, Linux and mobile
hero_feature_open_source: Open source — the whole thing is on GitHub
features_intro: What Pepo can do today and what is planned next.
feature_group_chat_blurb: Foundational support for your Twitch chatting needs
feature_chat_decorations: Show native Twitch chat events such as first-time chatter, resubs, watch streaks, etc.
feature_group_events_blurb: Real-time feed of channel and moderation activities.
feature_events_activity: See a real-time feed of support and moderation events
feature_events_deleted_messages: Choose how deleted messages are handled
feature_group_channels_blurb: Find channels faster and keep track of what is live.
feature_channels_live_sorting: Live status, viewer counts, live sorting
feature_channels_live_notifications: Alerts when favorite channels go live
feature_group_app_blurb: Desktop behavior, account identity, and future platforms.
install_intro: Download the latest release for your platform. Pepo will notify you when updates are available and update itself in-place.
